L41: Nov 2 (Reuters) - Deutsche Bank turned bullish on US technology stocks, reversing a downgrade made three weeks ago, saying a sharp selloff has created an attractive buying opportunity and much of the AI-related risk was already priced in.
L42: 
L43: More than $2 trillion was wiped off the 【17†Nasdaq 100】’s market value last month, as investors reassessed AI-related investments and growth expectations.
L44: 
L45: Here are more details from the brokerage’s Friday note:
L46: • Tech and mega-cap growth stocks have lagged the rest of the 【18†S&P 500】 by more than 16 percentage points over the past three weeks, falling about 11% while the broader index rose nearly 6%, leaving the sector near the low end of its historical trading range
L47: 
L48: • "Magnificent Seven" results reinforced investor concerns about the pace of returns from heavy AI spending, contributing to recent weakness in large-cap technology stocks
L49: • Technology’s relative performance has fallen to the bottom of its long-term range, a level that has marked attractive entry points in recent years
L50: 
L51: • Previous rotations back into tech have resulted in average gains of about 32% and roughly 30 percentage points of outperformance versus the rest of the S&P 500
L52: 
L53: • Overall equity positioning remains relatively light despite solid earnings growth, leaving room for investors to increase exposure if corporate profits remain resilient
